svg.aria-label: Flight data. Inside temperature started near 18 °C and fell as low as −28 °C; outside temperature fell to −52 °C at about 51 minutes. The Peltier voltage stayed between 0 and 40 millivolts. The full log is in data/tease-flight-data.csv.
